Document 2 is slightly more precise on mechanism (citing the specific comprehension-gap correlation and Goodhart risk) and adds a cannibalization signal, but Document 1 is equally rigorous and equally open-ended, so the gap is not meaningful.

Both reach the same clear kill call and name similar falsifiable conditions and stop signals, but Document 2's success conditions (e.g., 'non-engagement is empirically the dominant reason,' testable via an incremental-review holdout) are sharper and more specifically falsifiable, and its signals (opt-out rate, A/B on review quality vs. occurrence, no-nudge control) are more concretely operationalized with clearer timing.
